scoring_justification: The main claims (ωd constancy, specific A1g frequencies, mode counts) can be verified by recomputing from the agent's phonon results artifact and comparing to paper-reported numbers and geometric calculations.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported ωd constant, specific A1g mode frequencies for (12,12) and (12,0), and expected Raman/IR counts.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: Figure 1, text and Table 2. The ωd constancy is described as 223.7×10⁻⁷ for d>1.0 nm; frequencies: low A1g 137.5 cm⁻¹ (armchair), 237.8 cm⁻¹ (zigzag); high A1g 1585.2 cm⁻¹ (armchair), 1588.3 cm⁻¹ (zigzag).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper text and figures.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported quantities the paper claims.

armchair_item.gamma_modes: array of objects with keys: frequency_cm-1 (float), irrep (string), raman_active (bool), ir_active (bool)

outputs.description: Phonon frequencies at Γ point for armchair (n=4..19) and zigzag (n=5..19) nanotubes, along with symmetry classification, Raman/IR activity, and radial breathing mode identification.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the ω·d product for the radial breathing mode and verify constancy, compare specific A₁₉ mode frequencies within tolerances, and count Raman‑active (8) and IR‑active (3) modes; it will also verify that all irreducible representation labels belong to the D₂ₙₕ point group.

steps.description: Check that reported diameters are consistent with the nanotube geometry.
